beats.note: The Register reports only a few machines across Cloudflare's 102 data centres were hit, about 0.2 per cent of DNS queries and under 1 per cent of HTTP requests.

beats.text: A leap second went in at midnight.
beats.note: Added just before 2017. Cloudflare's Go based DNS software, RRDNS, timed upstream resolvers, and the clock could now run backwards.

beats.text: Go does not promise time moves forward.
beats.note: The Register notes Go gave no monotonicity guarantee, so a time difference could come out negative.

beats.text: A negative number made the code panic.
beats.note: RRDNS passed that value to rand.Int63n, which panics when given a negative argument.
The error check on rttMAX moved from equal to zero to equal or less than zero. The Register's headline credits a single character.

beats.context: The share of DNS queries affected, as The Register reports. One extra second.
